001package io.jstach.rainbowgum.slf4j.spi;
002
003import org.jspecify.annotations.Nullable;
004import org.slf4j.Logger;
005import org.slf4j.Marker;
006import org.slf4j.event.Level;
007import org.slf4j.spi.LoggingEventBuilder;
008import org.slf4j.spi.NOPLoggingEventBuilder;
009
010import io.jstach.rainbowgum.RainbowGum;
011import io.jstach.rainbowgum.slf4j.spi.LoggerDecoratorService.DepthAwareEventBuilder;
012import io.jstach.rainbowgum.slf4j.spi.LoggerDecoratorService.DepthAwareLogger;
013
014/**
015 * A base class for {@link LoggerDecoratorService} implementations that need to filter or
016 * enrich log calls without depending on {@link org.slf4j.helpers.AbstractLogger}'s
017 * internal dispatch, whose stack depth to the real caller is an unversioned SLF4J
018 * implementation detail rather than something Rainbow Gum controls or tests.
019 * <p>
020 * Every convenience method ({@code info(String)}, {@code error(String,Object)}, marker
021 * variants, ...) funnels through exactly one internal dispatch method before
022 * {@link #isEnabled(Level, Marker)} and {@link #decorate(LoggingEventBuilder, Marker)}
023 * run, so the frame count from any convenience method to caller-info capture is fixed and
024 * verified once by this class's own tests. Subclasses never need to reason about stack
025 * depth. Non-marker convenience methods pass a {@code null} marker to both hooks.
026 * <p>
027 * The fluent {@code atInfo()} style API ({@link #makeLoggingEventBuilder(Level)}) is a
028 * transparent pass-through to {@link #delegate()} and does <strong>not</strong> invoke
029 * either hook, since there is no populated event (or marker) to filter or decorate yet at
030 * that point.
031 *
032 * @see LoggerDecoratorService LoggerDecoratorService for a full example and how to
033 * register a decorator.
034 */
035/*
036 * The trace/debug/info/warn/error(Marker, String, Object, Object) overrides below match
037 * org.slf4j.Logger's own real parameter names (marker, format, arg1, arg2) exactly - the
038 * slf4j-api jar just isn't compiled with -parameters, so errorprone falls back to
039 * synthetic arg0..arg3 names and flags a mismatch that isn't actually there.
040 */
041@SuppressWarnings("OverridingMethodInconsistentArgumentNamesChecker")
042public abstract class AbstractFilteringLogger implements Logger, DepthAwareLogger {
043
044        /*
045         * Frames between builder.log() and the real caller: this class's own normalizedLog(),
046         * plus the public convenience method (info(), error(), marker variant, ...) that
047         * called it. Both are declared in this class - never delegate one convenience method
048         * to another, or that adds an untracked frame. Fixed and verified by
049         * AbstractFilteringLoggerTest.
050         */
051        private static final int DEPTH = 2;
052
053        private final DepthAwareLogger delegate;
054
055        /**
056         * Creates a filtering logger wrapping the given delegate.
057         * @param delegate logger to wrap.
058         */
059        protected AbstractFilteringLogger(DepthAwareLogger delegate) {
060                this.delegate = delegate;
061        }
062
063        /**
064         * The wrapped logger that ultimately receives log calls.
065         * @return delegate.
066         */
067        public DepthAwareLogger delegate() {
068                return delegate;
069        }
070
071        /**
072         * Cheap pre-check run before any {@link LoggingEventBuilder} is built, analogous to
073         * {@code isInfoEnabled()}/{@code isInfoEnabled(Marker)}. Override to filter out
074         * events (sampling, per-logger overrides, per-marker rules, ...) without paying for
075         * message formatting or key-value collection.
076         * @param level level of the event.
077         * @param marker marker passed to the convenience method that was called, or null if a
078         * non-marker overload was used.
079         * @return true if enabled and {@link #decorate(LoggingEventBuilder, Marker)} may run.
080         */
081        protected boolean isEnabled(Level level, @Nullable Marker marker) {
082                return true;
083        }
084
085        /**
086         * Called with the already-populated builder (message, arguments and cause already set
087         * from whatever convenience method arity the caller used). Override to add key
088         * values, rewrite the message, etc. The marker is passed here rather than added to
089         * the builder automatically, since there is no default meaningful behavior for it
090         * (e.g. a decorator can call
091         * {@code builder.addKeyValue("_marker", marker.toString())} if it wants markers
092         * surfaced at all).
093         * <p>
094         * {@code builder} also implements {@link DepthAwareEventBuilder}, whose
095         * {@code message()}/{@code throwable()}/{@code arguments()}/{@code keyValues()}
096         * expose what has already been set - needed for read-modify-write overrides (e.g.
097         * prefixing the message, redacting an argument) since plain
098         * {@link LoggingEventBuilder} has no such accessors. Use
099         * {@link DepthAwareEventBuilder}'s static {@code message(LoggingEventBuilder)}-style
100         * helpers rather than casting directly, in case a future delegate ever passes through
101         * a plain {@link LoggingEventBuilder} instead.
102         * <p>
103         * <strong>Do not call {@code builder.log()} directly from this method</strong> -
104         * doing so adds an untracked stack frame and caller info will point at the wrong
105         * line. To mutate and let it log normally, just mutate {@code builder} and return
106         * {@code true}. To log it yourself (e.g. conditionally, or more than once) use
107         * {@link #log(LoggingEventBuilder)} instead of {@code builder.log()}, and return
108         * {@code false} so this class does not log it again. To drop the event entirely, do
109         * neither and return {@code false}.
110         * @param builder builder about to be logged.
111         * @param marker marker passed to the convenience method that was called, or null if a
112         * non-marker overload was used.
113         * @return true to have this class call {@code builder.log()} after this method
114         * returns; false if you called {@link #log(LoggingEventBuilder)} yourself or want to
115         * drop the event.
116         * @see DepthAwareEventBuilder
117         */
118        protected boolean decorate(LoggingEventBuilder builder, @Nullable Marker marker) {
119                return true;
120        }
121
122        /**
123         * Logs a builder obtained from a {@link #decorate(LoggingEventBuilder, Marker)}
124         * override that returned {@code false}, with caller-info depth adjusted for the extra
125         * frames both {@link #decorate(LoggingEventBuilder, Marker)} and this method itself
126         * add. Never call {@code builder.log()} directly from
127         * {@link #decorate(LoggingEventBuilder, Marker)}.
128         * @param builder builder to log, previously handed to
129         * {@link #decorate(LoggingEventBuilder, Marker)}.
130         */
131        protected final void log(LoggingEventBuilder builder) {
132                /*
133                 * +2, not +1: the call chain here is normalizedLog() -> decorate() -> log() ->
134                 * builder.log(), i.e. both decorate() and this method are extra frames beyond the
135                 * normalizedLog()+convenience-method pair DEPTH already accounts for.
136                 */
137                DepthAwareEventBuilder.setDepth(builder, DEPTH + 2);
138                builder.log();
139        }
140
141        @Override
142        public String getName() {
143                return delegate.getName();
144        }
145
146        /**
147         * A no-op: unlike {@link org.slf4j.helpers.AbstractLogger}-based decorators, this
148         * class's caller-info depth is a fixed internal constant rather than derived from the
149         * wrap-count
150         * {@link LoggerDecoratorService#decorate(RainbowGum, DepthAwareLogger, int)} passes
151         * in, so there is nothing to recreate.
152         * @param depth ignored.
153         * @return this.
154         */
155        @Override
156        public Logger withDepth(int depth) {
157                return this;
158        }
159
160        @Override
161        public boolean isEnabledForLevel(Level level) {
162                return isEnabledForLevel(level, null);
163        }
164
165        private boolean isEnabledForLevel(Level level, @Nullable Marker marker) {
166                return delegate.isEnabledForLevel(level) && isEnabled(level, marker);
167        }
168
169        @Override
170        public LoggingEventBuilder makeLoggingEventBuilder(Level level) {
171                if (!delegate.isEnabledForLevel(level)) {
172                        return NOPLoggingEventBuilder.singleton();
173                }
174                return delegate.makeLoggingEventBuilder(level);
175        }
176
177        /*
178         * LoggingEventBuilder mutates itself and returns this, so a builder call is never
179         * actually "unused" just because its return value is discarded here - the real
180         * mistake to guard against is forgetting the terminal log()/decorate() call, which
181         * this method never does.
182         */
183        @SuppressWarnings("CheckReturnValue")
184        private void normalizedLog(Level level, @Nullable Marker marker, @Nullable String message, @Nullable Object arg1,
185                        @Nullable Object arg2, @Nullable Object @Nullable [] argArray, @Nullable Throwable throwable) {
186                if (!isEnabledForLevel(level, marker)) {
187                        return;
188                }
189                var builder = DepthAwareEventBuilder.setDepth(delegate.makeLoggingEventBuilder(level), DEPTH);
190                if (message != null) {
191                        builder.setMessage(message);
192                }
193                if (arg1 != null) {
194                        builder.addArgument(arg1);
195                }
196                if (arg2 != null) {
197                        builder.addArgument(arg2);
198                }
199                if (argArray != null) {
200                        for (var a : argArray) {
201                                builder.addArgument(a);
202                        }
203                }
204                if (throwable != null) {
205                        builder.setCause(throwable);
206                }
207                if (decorate(builder, marker)) {
208                        builder.log();
209                }
210        }
211
